messages:
Jenna (Finance): FYI — AWS invoice 987654321 shows line items in EUR and the conversion used by the portal doesn't match our treasury FX feed. We're ~ $1,100 over expected on one invoice.
Omar (Billing): Ugh. did the marketplace listing change currency? can you paste the raw invoice/pdf?
Jenna (Finance): link: https://s3.redwood-internal/finance/invoices/987654321.pdf — PDF attached in billing system.
aws-ingest-bot: Invoice 987654321 processed at 2026-03-15T08:22:11Z — currency: EUR — amount_gross: 9800 EUR — amount_converted: 10900 USD (rate 1.112).
Liam (RevOps): Checking our AWS marketplace account settings — looks like the partner updated listing storefront currency last week. pulling audit trail now.
Omar (Billing): can we confirm which FX rate source was used during ingestion? we want daily-close from treasury (our system), not AWS runtime conv.
Jenna (Finance): Our ledger shows it imported using the AWS conversion. Treasury feed for 2026-03-12 had EUR->USD = 1.085 — expected USD ~10623. That leaves an unexplained delta of $277. Requesting vendor credit or adjustment.
Liam (RevOps): I'll open a case with AWS marketplace support. Created case AM-20260315-42. @Maria (Finance-Lead) do we need a provisional GL adjustment in the meantime?
Maria (Finance-Lead): Yes — please post a provisional FX revaluation entry: debit COGS 277 USD, credit FX gain 277 USD, tag invoice 987654321 and annotate 'pending AWS credit'. Approve? :ok_hand:
Omar (Billing): Approved. I'll attach the GL entry to the invoice record and notify accounting for month-end accruals.
Jenna (Finance): Thanks. Action list: 1) Liam: escalate to AWS for partner conversion mismatch and request credit memo; 2) Omar: create provisional GL entry; 3) Finance ops: add alert if partner listing currency changes again. I'll update when AWS responds.
aws-ingest-bot: Support case AM-20260315-42 created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/AM-20260315-42
Liam (RevOps): AWS replied — partner acknowledged the storefront currency change was accidental and has issued a marketplace credit of 277 USD; will appear on next invoice cycle.
Jenna (Finance): Perfect — when the credit memo posts, I'll reverse the provisional entry and close the invoice.
Omar (Billing): Noted. Marking this thread resolved for billing ops. :white_check_mark:
Jenna (Finance): Closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll follow up if any residual reconciliation gaps show up in next close.
